subject: AmplifyPay renewal: usage insights, pilot & procurement path
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Singh <anita.singh@novuspay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — usage signals, ops priorities, and next steps

Hi Anita / Rajiv — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap so we have aligned next steps and can share the materials procurement asked for.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- Production latency spikes during month-end reconciliation (P95 ~= 1.2s) impacting downstream payment matching jobs.
- Unpredictable per-token costs across RAG workloads — finance needs a predictable commit for forecasting.
- Ingest latency for new documents (large PDFs) slows RAG updates; ops wants faster refresh (target < 15 min).

Goals we discussed:
- Reduce reconciliation P95 latency to <= 400ms for the 95th percentile of requests for the critical flow.
- Establish a committed throughput tier (tokens/sec or concurrent streams) with pricing that reduces unit cost ~25%.
- Run a 3-month pilot for dedicated capacity to validate latency and cost assumptions, then roll into a 12-month reserved contract if metrics hit targets.

Immediate next steps (owner in parentheses):
1) I shared a one-line usage export attached (usage_report_Oct2026.csv) for your procurement/finance (Evelyn).
2) We'll propose a pilot SOW and pricing tiers by EOD Friday (Marcus / Grace).
3) Procurement questionnaire attached — if you can complete and return by Nov 11 we can fast-track security review (Anita / Rajiv).
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra team to validate ingest and latency fixes (Karthik to lead; send 2-3 windows).

Attachments: [Attachment: usage_report_Oct2026.csv (CSV, 42KB)], [Attachment: procurement_questionnaire_novuspay.xlsx (XLSX, 180KB)]

Proposed timeline:
- 11/3: This recap + attachments (today)
- 11/5: Redwood internal pricing + SOW draft to NovusPay
- 11/9–11/11: Procurement returns questionnaire, schedule procurement call
- 11/16–11/20: Pilot kickoff (target week)

If that matches your view, I’ll queue the SOW draft and a short pilot runbook.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[evelyn.hart@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference
From: Anita Singh <anita.singh@novuspay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Malhotra <rajiv.malhotra@novuspay.com>, NovusPay Procurement <procurement@novuspay.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 10:05:12 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — usage signals, ops priorities, and next steps

Thanks, Evelyn — this is helpful and captures the conversation. A few clarifications from procurement / engineering: 

- Procurement asks for SOC 2 evidence (Type II) and a basic data flow diagram before the contract is signed. Can Redwood provide pointer links or a short packet?
- Implementation constraints: our compliance team is requesting a 60-day window from signed SOW to production for the dedicated pilot. Is that workable?
- For pricing, we need a committed throughput number and a clear overage rate; finance prefers a blended monthly commit rather than per-minute metering.

We completed the attached procurement questionnaire with initial answers — you'll see some blanks where we need Redwood input. Once we have the SOW + pilot details we can route to legal.

Available for a short procurement sync on Friday 11/6 between 09:00–11:00 ET or Monday 11/9 after 13:00 ET. Let me know what works.

Best,
Anita Singh
Head of Platform Ops, NovusPay
[anita.singh@novuspay.com]
[Attachment: procurement_questionnaire_novuspay.xlsx (XLSX, 180KB)]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: NovusPay pricing & pilot proposal (draft)

Evelyn / Grace — quick internal note after Anita's reply. Draft plan I suggest we share Friday: 

Pilot scope (3 months):
- Dedicated pool: 2x A40-equivalent GPUs with autoscale headroom to handle month-end spikes (burst to 4 GPUs for 2 hours/day).
- KV/prefix caching enabled for reconciliation flow + prioritization queue for the payment-matching endpoint.
- Success criteria: P95 <= 400ms for reconciliation samples in Canon dataset; ingest latency < 15 min for PDFs; 20–30% overall unit cost improvement vs current usage.

Pricing (proposal):
- Pilot monthly commit: $35k/mo (3-month minimum) — includes a one-time integration credit of $15k to offset onboarding/doT.
- Post-pilot reserved option: 12-mo commit at 15% discount off listed usage price; overage at 1.5x base rate.

Compliance/Docs: attach SOW draft and link to SOC 2 packet (internal doc). We should also prep a short data-flow diagram for procurement.

Action items:
- Grace: finalize SOW draft + runbook by EOD Thu (11/5).
- Karthik: propose 2 slots for technical deep-dive (11/10 or 11/12).
- Evelyn: resend SOW + pricing to Anita with DocuSign option and the usage export.

I attached the SOW skeleton: SOW_Redwood_NovusPay_RevA.pdf (internal draft).

-Marcus
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_Redwood_NovusPay_RevA.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — usage signals, ops priorities, and next steps

Hi Anita / Rajiv — following up with the items Marcus / Grace and I agreed to.

Attachments included: SOW_Redwood_NovusPay_RevA.pdf (draft SOW), usage_report_Oct2026.csv, procurement_questionnaire_novuspay.xlsx (with our input in the comment fields).

Summary of what we changed based on your asks:
- SOC 2: added a pointer in the SOW to our Type II packet and attached a short data flow diagram (see SOW appendix).
- Timing: pilot proposed to start week of 11/16 with a 60-day expected ramp to pilot steady-state; full production after pilot and legal sign-off (we're flexible if your team needs faster start).
- Pricing: pilot commit $35k/mo for a 3-month minimum; includes a $15k one-time integration credit. Post-pilot reserved option and overage terms are in section 4 of the SOW.

Next steps for NovusPay:
1) Review the SOW and procurement questionnaire updates — can you confirm by COB 11/11?
2) Book a 30-min procurement + legal sync (we're available Friday 11/6 09:00–11:00 ET or Mon 11/9 13:00–16:00 ET; if those are closed, propose two windows).
3) If you confirm, I'll convert the SOW to DocuSign and include the HubSpot deal link for signature routing.

Quoting your line: "our compliance team is requesting a 60-day window from signed SOW to production for the dedicated pilot. Is that workable?" — Yes, that aligns with the timeline above; we'll add a short runbook to the SOW outlining milestones.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn
